purpose: Every customer-facing promise, where it is shown, and the check that proves it is still true. scripts/promise_gate.py fails pre-commit and CI when a check fails. A promise whose copy changes must change here too: each surface entry quotes the text the page must still contain.

verifier_types.grep: must_contain: [{path, pattern}] regex must match in the file; must_not_contain: [{paths, pattern}] regex must match in none of the globbed files; only_in: [{paths, pattern, allowed}] regex may match only in the allowed files. Patterns are Python regex, multiline, case-sensitive unless flags contains 'i'.
verifier_types.gh-api: endpoint + field + expect: `gh api <endpoint> --jq .<field>` must equal expect (case-insensitive). Skipped with --offline or when gh is unavailable, unless --strict (CI).
verifier_types.sql: query + expect: run via psql against $PROMISE_DATABASE_URL; skipped when that is unset (CI has no prod DB). Fails only on a real mismatch.
verifier_types.manual: verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD) + max_age_days + how: fails when the last human check is older than max_age_days. Re-verify, then bump verified_on.
